Name: Inflection Partners, LLC
Description:
Since 2015, Inflection Partners, LLC has functioned as a vehicle for the family office and consulting activities of Dave Sherry and Pam Bonnie, related to technology, power and sustainable finance.                                                                             

Founded by Dave Sherry and Jack Andrews, Inflection Partners, LLC was registered as an investment advisor with the California Department of Corporations from 2004 to 2011 and the United States Securities & Exchange Commission from 2011 to 2014.  

▶️ The firm managed a limited partnership with a long/short strategy focused on technology, media and telecommunication equities that launched in 2005.  
▶️ The mission was that of a true hedge fund  to generate significant absolute returns in all market conditions. 
▶️ The approach was to apply deep fundamental research to take advantage of the volatility of stock price movements in these sectors by adopting a variant perspective to identify where the consensus view was flawed and where opportunity could be realized.  
▶️ The results were an attractive return stream that accrued alpha from both the long and short sides and that was uncorrelated with any other fund in the Alphametrix database of 5000 funds.

In conjunction with SEC registration, Inflection Partners acted as a sub-advisor to the Hatteras Alpha Hedged Strategies Fund, a pioneer and largest of 1940 Act mutual funds that invested in hedged strategies.  Additional sub-advisor roles followed with SCA Absolute Return Fund and SCA Directional Fund.

Special Situations & Opportunities is an investment research arm of the University of Southern California's Global Investment Society.

Each semester, Special Situations & Opportunities selects a small number of students with demonstrated strength in corporate finance, capital structure analysis, and financial restructuring to form a tight-knit team of analysts. Selected members will originate, underwrite, and present investment ideas to leading alternative investment managers and restructuring/capital solutions groups, building institutional-quality investment committee materials from the ground up even as an undergraduate. 

 Members engage directly with senior professionals at mega-funds and advisory platforms - gaining mentorship, deal exposure, and recruiting access that reflects the caliber of work they produce.

Admission is by application only and based solely on analytical merit. Viewership of weekly committee meetings is open to all undergraduates. 

Alumni and current members will pursue careers in financial restructuring, special situations investing, private debt, private equity, investment banking, and specialty finance at the industry's most selective firms.
